reviews.t: Wakes You Up in the Morning Better Than Coffee
reviews.x: Imagine scrubbing your whole body with lava rocks while taking a shower or bath. Your skin will hate you first but love you later when it feels rejuvenated and awake. This one is the hardest and most coarse Japanese washcloth I have used in years.  Just like trying to develop a taste for Hot Sauce, try starting easy first with Japanese washcloths if you are new to them. Go with soft to medium first before moving on to Hard or Super Hard or you will annihilate yourself before even starting.

This is my 2nd purchase of the Salux Super Hard version and it feels thinner than the first one.  This is the blue, a lovely shade.  Also, not as rough and exfoliating as the first one I bought.  The first Salux Super Hard was in white.  The material should be the same.  Good but I prefer the rougher, exfoliating like the first white one I received.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the strong exfoliation and resulting soft, smooth skin.
Many note the cloth is very coarse or rough, especially at first, and recommend building up to it or starting with a regular version.
Several reviewers say it is safe for sensitive skin or works well for specific skin issues.
Some reviewers describe it as a quality upgrade over regular Salux or other brands.
One reviewer reports receiving the wrong product and being unable to return it.
